result.brief: 提出 IGNITE 聚变等离子体世界基础模型，用多模态时空 tokenizer 与自回归动力学模型在潜空间预测完整放电过程，为多模态世界建模与表征学习提供架构参考。
result.reason: Self-supervised generative world foundation model with spatio-temporal tokenizers and autoregressive latent dynamics over multimodal plasma data; contributes world modeling and representation architecture.
